_comment: Known-violations ratchet for fallow's dead-code analysis, banked by #261 — the issue that made the four FALLOW conformity checks run at all. Before it, `fallow` was not a declared dependency, every check printed 'this check did NOT run' and the suite reported 43/44 green over a tree nothing had looked at. Installing it surfaced these findings all at once; fixing them is a refactor of src/graph and src/promote and is not this issue. Each number is the count fallow reports with `.fallowrc.json`'s ignoreFindings REMOVED — the unsuppressed tree. The paths in that ignoreFindings list are what keeps the conformity checks green, and `test/fallow-baseline.test.ts` is what stops the list becoming an exemption list: it re-runs fallow unsuppressed and refuses in BOTH directions against these counts, refuses a banked path that no longer owns a finding, and refuses if the suppressed reading the conformity checks see is not empty. Lower a number only in the same commit that earns it, and delete a path from ignoreFindings when it stops owning findings.
